# SizeMint

> SizeMint is a free browser-based image toolkit. Compress JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF images
> down to a target file size — 20KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB, 1MB, or any custom size — convert
> between formats, resize by pixels or percent, and crop images. Everything runs entirely in
> the user's browser. Images are never uploaded to a server; no account needed.

## Tools

- [Image Compressor](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/): shrink images to an exact target
  file size (20KB–5MB presets or custom). Reports the real final size, dimensions, and whether
  the target was reached.
- [Image Format Converter](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/convert): convert between JPG,
  PNG, WebP, and AVIF with automatic format detection of the uploaded file.
- [Image Resizer](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/resize): resize by exact pixels or by
  percent, with aspect-ratio lock.
- [Image Cropper](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/crop): drag-to-crop with square, 4:3,
  and 16:9 presets; PNG or JPG output.

## Guides

- [Compress image to 20KB](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/compress-to-20kb): hit an exact
  20KB target for exam forms and uploads, step by step.
- [Compress image to 50KB](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/compress-to-50kb): 50KB targets
  for passport photos, email attachments, and form uploads.
- [Compress image to 100KB](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/compress-to-100kb): four steps
  to exactly 100KB.
- [Reduce photo to 100KB](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/reduce-photo-to-100kb): ID and
  portrait photos at 100KB, including an EXIF note.
- [Compress image to 200KB](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/compress-to-200kb): 200KB
  targets and what quality to expect.
- [Compress signature to 20KB](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/compress-signature-20kb):
  scan, crop to ~140x60 px, and compress signatures for SSC/IBPS/bank exam forms.
- [Signature guide](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/signature-guide): make a compliant
  exam-form signature; JPG vs PNG for signatures; common failures.
- [Exam photo guide](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/exam-photo-guide): photo and signature
  sizes for SSC, UPSC, IBPS, NEET, and Railway forms.
- [WebP vs JPG](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/webp-vs-jpg): which format is smaller, with
  real file sizes at matched quality; where AVIF fits.
- [Compress PNG without losing quality](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/compress-png-quality):
  lossless optimization vs palette quantization.
- [Compress without uploading](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/no-upload-compressor): how
  browser-local compression works and how to verify the no-upload claim.
- [TinyPNG alternative](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/tinypng-alternative): honest
  comparison of free image compressors.
- [All guides](https://sizemint.tool-web.workers.dev/guides): the full guide index.

## Common questions (short answers)

- Does SizeMint upload my images? No. The tools process images locally in the browser.
- Can it hit an exact file size like 20KB? It targets the size and reports the real result;
  exact sizes depend on image content, dimensions, and format.
- Is it free? Yes. No account, no signup, no watermarks.
- Which formats are supported? JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF input; JPG, PNG, WebP output.
- Why target file size instead of quality? Upload forms enforce byte limits, so a target size
  maps directly to what the form accepts.

## Privacy

- Images are processed locally in the browser and never sent to a SizeMint server.
- No user accounts. No first-party cookies for the core tools.
